self.reason: Provides the app its own identity (app_id) and access to its tarball entries and PNG metadata chunks.

self_write.reason: Writes card state (character_book, top-level card fields, extensions) back to the card PNG so the card is self-contained and sharing the file shares everything.

kv.reason: Stores and retrieves connection, generation, and prompt presets via presets.lua (list keys + active-preset keys per type). Also persists the active session ID across restarts.

time.reason: Provides a wall-clock timestamp source available to all entries; used by the platform runtime for session bookkeeping.

server.reason: Accepts HTTP requests and routes POST /chat, POST /chat-stream, GET /count-tokens, and all conversation management endpoints.

llm.reason: Invokes llm.call and llm.call_stream to send assembled message sequences to the language model and stream back the assistant's reply. key_name identifies the keyring entry (crescent/anthropic) used to resolve the API key.

conversations.reason: Shared SQLite database for conversation sessions and messages. The server sets up the schema on init (idempotent) and accesses the db via raw SQL helpers. Falls back to an in-memory lib/conversation db when absent.

server.reason: Accepts HTTP requests and routes POST /api/import/png and POST /api/import/json to the CCv2 card parser.
